biotools.summary: Mol Biology Tools is a free browser-based suite for sequence analysis, primer design, plasmid editing and wet-lab calculations. Its sequence tools cover PCR and Sanger primer design, primer walking plans, binding checks, screening primers against a selected DNA reference, restriction site analysis, reverse complements, ORF finding, DNA-to-protein translation and codon optimisation. Assembly PCR, Gibson assembly and site-directed mutagenesis designers support cloning design, while Plasmid Editor lets users inspect and edit supplied DNA and annotations. Calculators cover ligation, molarity, dilution, buffer preparation and multi-solute solution recipes. The tools process input sequences locally in the browser, without requiring an account or uploading those sequences to a server.

function.note: Primer Scan screens supplied primer pairs against a selected assembled DNA reference and reports candidate matches and products. Primer Binding Checker maps supplied primers on a particular template. Predictions depend on the supplied reference and settings; they do not establish PCR success.
Codon Optimizer edits a coding DNA sequence using selected codon preferences while preserving the translated protein. It does not predict a genetic code or guarantee expression performance.

PCR primer design includes the PCR, Assembly PCR, Gibson Assembly and Site-Directed Mutagenesis designers. Supplied templates or fragment sequences determine the proposed primers and predicted construct; designs require template-specific review and experimental validation.
Plasmid Editor supports manual editing of supplied DNA and annotations, linked map/sequence views and sequence or map export. It does not automatically annotate missing features.

bioschemas.summary: Molecular Biology Tools is a free browser-based collection of molecular biology utilities for routine sequence analysis, primer design, Sanger sequencing primer planning, cloning setup, and wet-lab calculations. The site includes tools for PCR primer design, Sanger primer design and primer walking, primer binding checks, restriction site analysis, reverse complement generation, ORF and protein translation, codon optimization, ligation calculations, molarity calculations, dilution calculations, and multi-solute solution recipe preparation. The tools run in the browser and are intended for quick experimental planning, without requiring logins or uploading sequences to the server.
